items.title: Tether's excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer's US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion.

items.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.
